entries.1cc514cef92aa9bc: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Torasuto Fudōsan Kaihatsu. Under the concept of 'housing that will be loved for generations to come, for people, for towns and for the next generation,' the company plans, develops and sells residential properties, centered on the sale of family condominiums. During the current fiscal year, 2 new condominium buildings were completed and 68 units were delivered.
entries.43c4175cbbcb1d1b: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Torasuto Pāku and Torasuto Asetto Pātonāzu. Under the Act on Specified Joint Real Estate Business, it sells small-unit parking investment products called 'Torasuto Pātonāzu' and supports customers' long-term, stable asset management. During the current fiscal year, it structured 3 products, Nos. 38 to 40, all of which sold out.
entries.66ed204ba852bbb1: Consolidated subsidiary Torasuto Patorōru provides machine-based security related to the parking business and on-site security guards at commercial facilities. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.6abd694977e5c438: Investor customers who purchase small-unit investment products
entries.876fabd090137ebe: This is the core business carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Torasuto Pāku and Guranshippu. Under the concept of 'effective use of idle land' and 'revitalization of existing parking facilities,' the company operates hourly and monthly parking lots on land leased from landowners, and also undertakes parking management contracts. As of June 30, 2026, there were 1,010 parking lots with 33,856 parking spaces. Torasuto Pāku also operates the parking information website 'Torasuto Nabi.'
entries.9755275cb0b2b364: Businesses such as commercial facilities requesting security services
entries.ad2024d837ee2fa1: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Torasuto Medikaru Sapōto and Kama no Shō. Through real estate leasing to medical institutions and other entities, money-lending business and various consulting services, it provides safe and secure medical environments to medical institutions that serve local healthcare.
entries.aedeeac8fdab818d: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary ＲＶ Torasuto. Under the concept of 'supporting a new lifestyle,' the company manufactures, sells, customizes, repairs and renovates campervans. It has a manufacturing plant in Yokote City, Akita Prefecture.
entries.bfe35d47a7d01951: This category comprises businesses not included in reportable segments. It includes the operation of hot bath facilities, security services, the water business, the operation of golf driving ranges and others.
